title: Card payment and duplicate-charge policy
content: Card-payment and duplicate-charge reports are reviewed by the Payments team. The system must not promise a reversal or refund until transaction records are verified.

title: Unauthorized transaction policy
content: Potentially unauthorized card payments, cash withdrawals, or transfers are security-sensitive. The ticket is escalated to a human agent for secure investigation.

title: Card delivery and replacement policy
content: For card delivery, replacement, or tracking questions, Card Operations verifies the request and delivery records. The system must not invent a card-arrival date.

title: Bank transfer policy
content: For pending, failed, or recipient-related transfers, Transfers Support verifies transfer details before providing an outcome. Automated responses must not claim a transfer has completed.

title: Account security policy
content: For passcode resets, account lockouts, or verification questions, Account Security uses the approved recovery process. Never request passwords, PINs, or full security credentials in support messages.

title: Currency exchange policy
content: Exchange-rate and cash-conversion questions require reference to the applicable policy or live pricing system. The system must not invent an exchange rate or fee.

title: Human agent policy
content: Customers may request a human support agent at any time. Explicit human-agent requests are routed to the Human Escalation Queue.
